q: How do I become a member?

q: How can I submit a prayer request?
a: You can submit a prayer request by replying to this message, filling out a prayer card at Sunday service, or calling the church office. All requests are kept confidential and prayed over by our pastoral team.

q: Does the church have children's ministry?
a: Yes! We offer nursery care for infants and toddlers, and children's church (ages 3–12) during both Sunday morning services. Children check in at the Children's Wing entrance.

q: How do I volunteer or serve?

q: How do I give or donate?
a: You can give online at [GIVING_URL], via the church app, by text to [GIVING_NUMBER], or in person at Sunday service. All giving is tax-deductible and a receipt will be emailed to you.

q: Are there small groups or Bible studies?
